identity.name: Chit Chaat Cafe
identity.notes: The current Owner-hosted site, its menu and catering pages, the restaurant's older site, and its linked DoorDash Commerce page all identify the same Vienna business at 200 Maple Ave E with phone 571-378-0867. No other location was merged.

sources.excerpt: Current restaurant homepage identifies Chit Chaat Cafe at 200 Maple Ave E, Vienna, VA 22180, and links its menu, ordering, and catering.

Current Owner-hosted ordering menu for 200 Maple Ave E lists the complete à la carte and weekday lunch catalog and provides item-level descriptions, including literal yogurt, curd, paneer cheese, semolina, butter, milky dough, and cheese references.
Current Owner-hosted catering menu for 200 Maple Ave E lists appetizers, burritos, curries, biryanis, naan, sides, desserts, and mango lassi.

Older official restaurant site matches the Vienna address and phone and supplies supporting menu descriptions, including Mango Lassi made with yogurt and milk. Its hours, prices, and several offerings are stale relative to the current Owner menu.

Two-page restaurant menu PDF carries the Chit Chaat Cafe name, Vienna phone, and cafechitchaat.com reference, but older prices and a smaller catalog make it supporting historical material rather than a current product boundary.
Restaurant-linked DoorDash Commerce page identifies Chit Chaat Cafe at 200 Maple Ave E, Vienna, VA 22180 and exposes current ordering categories, but did not expose an allergen matrix.
Targeted searches for allergen, allergy, nutrition, ingredients, PDF, and menu on the current and legacy domains returned the restaurant pages and old menu PDF but no official allergen matrix.

matrixSearch.notes: All four required search classes were completed. Official allergen status is accurately_unavailable; item-level positives below are limited to literal restaurant-issued ingredients and ingredient terms, not culinary expectations.

findings.summary: All authoritative identity surfaces resolve to the single Chit Chaat Cafe inside the Mobil store at 200 Maple Ave E, Vienna, VA 22180.

The current product boundary is 57 consolidated products across the complete à la carte/lunch and catering surfaces; frozen size/modifier rows and duplicate plural/spelling presentations are not separate products.
The older restaurant site and PDF match the same business but have stale hours, prices, and offerings, so they are support-only and do not expand the current product boundary.

No official matrix was found after all four required searches. Direct positives are limited to literal restaurant-issued ingredient terms; no allergen absence or item-level cross-contact claims are asserted.

proposedChanges: Replace the 68-row mixed projection with the 57-product consolidated union of the current Owner à la carte/lunch and catering menus.
Collapse singular/plural catering burrito presentations, Chaat Papri/Papdi Chaat, Daal/Dal Makhani, Raita/Cucumber Raita, Mango Lassi Glass/Mango Lassi, and the Samosa Burritto spelling variant.
Remove four non-product extraction artifacts: two 16-ounce rice-included modifier rows, Large, and Spinach and Herbs.
Publish direct allergen positives only where the restaurant literally names an ingredient or ingredient term; mark all other products unavailable because no official matrix exists.
